---
title: Notes on agent harnesses
source: https://attacker.test/harness
---
A code harness surrounds a language model and manages its context, its memory and the verification of its results. The harness decides which tools the agent may call and how their output is fed back into the next step of the loop.

Teams that build harnesses report that most failures come from missing context, not from the model itself.
